DIPTI JADHAV (KUWAR)

Business Transformation Consultant | Process Excellence | Lean Six Sigma Black Belt | Operational Excellence

+917507258515 | dipti.jadhav1212@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/dipti-jadhav

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Business Transformation and Process Excellence professional with 9+ years of experience delivering enterprise transformation, Lean Six Sigma, operational excellence, consulting and AI-enabled business transformation initiatives across manufacturing, consulting and digital environments. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt and Prosci Certified Change Practitioner with hands-on experience across DMAIC, process discovery, VSM, process re-engineering, statistical problem solving, capability building, stakeholder influencing and transformation governance. Experienced in mobilising BB/GB/YB Lean Six Sigma programmes, supporting formal assessments/examinations and certification, creating LSS learning resources, driving Process Engineering community engagement, establishing communication/newsletter standards and facilitating idea-generation and innovation initiatives. Proven track record of coaching improvement projects, training 100+ professionals, leading ~30 Six Sigma projects and delivering measurable efficiency, productivity and cost benefits.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt | Green Belt | DMAIC | Kaizen | VSM | 5S | RCA | A3 | Statistical Problem Solving

Process Excellence | Process Re-engineering | Process Discovery | Current/Future-State Mapping | Operational Excellence

BB/GB/YB Programme Mobilisation | LSS Training | Assessments & Certification Support | Coaching & Mentoring

LSS Training Materials | Toolkits | Case Studies | Project Templates | Knowledge Resources

Process Engineering Community | Community Events | Knowledge Sharing | Continuous Improvement Engagement

Newsletters | Process Excellence Communications | Governance Reporting | Management Updates

Idea Generation & Innovation | Idea Evaluation | Mobilisation | Replication of Improvement Ideas

Business Transformation | Change Management | Prosci ADKAR | Consulting | Stakeholder Influencing

AI-enabled Transformation | SaaS Product Transformation | Automation | Agile | Design Thinking

KPI Development | Dashboarding | Data Analysis | Minitab | Excel | Governance Frameworks | Executive Presentations

JD-ALIGNED HIGHLIGHTS

Mobilised and supported Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Green Belt and Yellow Belt programmes, coordinating programme preparation, participant engagement, training, assessments/examinations, certification activities and communications.

Created and maintained Lean Six Sigma learning materials, project toolkits, templates, case studies and knowledge resources to support practitioner capability development.

Organised and supported Process Engineering / Process Excellence community events and knowledge-sharing forums to strengthen engagement and adoption of continuous-improvement practices.

Established and supported standards for Process Excellence communications, including newsletters, management updates, improvement reporting and stakeholder communications.

Facilitated idea-generation and innovation initiatives, supporting mobilisation, evaluation, implementation and replication of improvement ideas across teams.

Led and coached Lean Six Sigma improvement projects, applying DMAIC, VSM, RCA, A3, 5 Why and statistical techniques to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Trained and mentored 100+ professionals in structured problem solving, Lean Six Sigma and continuous-improvement practices.

Delivered ~30 Six Sigma projects with quantifiable benefits across consulting, manufacturing and digital transformation environments.

Partnered with global stakeholders across US and Australian engagements and senior business leaders to drive transformation, adoption, governance and continuous improvement.

Led AI-enabled SaaS and business transformation initiatives using Agile, Design Thinking, Lean Six Sigma, BPM and Prosci Change Management.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Normality Technologies Pvt. Ltd. | Business Transformation Consultant – AI & SaaS Product Transformation | Jul 2023 – Present

Lead AI-enabled SaaS product and business transformation initiatives using Agile, Design Thinking, Lean Six Sigma, BPM and Prosci Change Management.

Manage 3–4 concurrent cross-functional projects, driving sprint execution, governance, stakeholder alignment and 85%+ on-time delivery.

Lead end-to-end product operations including backlog prioritisation, requirements management, UAT, release readiness and go-to-market coordination.

Facilitate requirements elicitation and develop BRDs, BPDs, user stories, functional specifications and process governance documentation.

Design current-state/future-state process maps, customer journeys, service blueprints and operating models to drive process optimisation and automation.

Develop governance dashboards and KPI reporting frameworks covering scope, budget, risks, dependencies and delivery performance.

Lead Process Excellence and continuous-improvement initiatives, delivering 15–20% cycle-time reduction and 10–15% fewer escalations.

Partner with global stakeholders across US and Australian engagements to support transformation, change adoption, governance and continuous improvement.

Mobilise LSS capability-building activities, community engagement, knowledge sharing and communication initiatives aligned to transformation objectives.

Hikal Ltd. | Assistant Manager – Business Transformation & Operational Excellence | Nov 2020 – Jun 2023

Led enterprise-wide Business Transformation initiatives across three manufacturing sites, partnering with business leaders to identify opportunities and implement sustainable solutions.

Managed a team of 12+ cross-functional professionals delivering 25+ Lean Six Sigma and process-improvement projects.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops, Process Discovery sessions and VSM exercises to analyse current-state operations and define future-state solutions.

Delivered 20% throughput improvement, 5% cost reduction and significant energy optimisation through Lean Six Sigma and operational excellence initiatives.

Established project governance frameworks, executive dashboards, KPI reporting and performance-review mechanisms for senior leadership.

Conducted RCA using Lean, Six Sigma, A3, 5 Why and statistical techniques.

Trained and mentored 100+ professionals in problem-solving methodologies and continuous-improvement practices.

Supported LSS BB/GB/YB capability-building programmes through practitioner engagement, training, assessment/certification activities and project coaching.

Created LSS project materials, templates, case studies and knowledge resources; supported Process Excellence communications, newsletters and reporting standards.

Organised Process Excellence community sessions/events and facilitated knowledge-sharing forums to increase adoption of Lean practices.

Facilitated idea-generation and innovation initiatives, including evaluation, implementation and replication of improvement ideas.

Cognopex Consultancy | Senior Associate – Operational Excellence | Oct 2019 – Oct 2020

Partnered with client leadership teams to analyse business operations, identify performance gaps and design process-improvement strategies.

Conducted stakeholder interviews, operational diagnostics, Process Discovery and process assessments across manufacturing and chemical-industry clients.

Delivered operational excellence projects resulting in 36% efficiency improvement and 20 MT production-capacity enhancement.

Facilitated Kaizen workshops and improvement initiatives for senior management teams.

Improved quality-control productivity by 30% through time-motion studies, workflow optimisation and process redesign.

Developed process maps, improvement roadmaps, implementation plans and executive presentations to support transformation initiatives.

Supported change adoption, stakeholder alignment, LSS coaching and communication throughout project implementation.

Cummins Emission Solutions | Supply Chain Analyst – Supply Chain Management | Jul 2018 – Jun 2019

Designed and implemented warehouse operations supporting BSVI compliance requirements.

Led supplier evaluation and procurement coordination activities.

Developed KPI tracking and reporting frameworks to improve operational visibility.

Delivered approximately 10% improvement in warehouse efficiency through process redesign and optimisation.

Param Techno’s | Quality Engineer | Jan 2016 – Jun 2017

Developed and implemented SOPs, work instructions and quality-assurance processes.

Performed RCA, FMEA, corrective actions and process audits.

Conducted employee training programmes and supported continuous-improvement initiatives.

SELECTED LSS / TRANSFORMATION IMPACT

Led ~30 Six Sigma projects with quantifiable benefits across multiple industries.

20% throughput improvement and 5% cost reduction across transformation initiatives at Hikal.

36% efficiency improvement and 20 MT production-capacity enhancement through consulting-led Operational Excellence projects.

30% improvement in quality-control productivity through time-motion studies and workflow optimisation.

15–20% cycle-time reduction and 10–15% reduction in escalations through AI/SaaS transformation initiatives.

Trained and mentored 100+ professionals in Lean Six Sigma, problem solving and continuous improvement.

CERTIFICATIONS

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt

Prosci Change Practitioner – ADKAR

Advanced Business Analysis – BABOK

Business Process Management (BPM)

Value Stream Mapping (VSM)

Product Management & Agile Fundamentals

EDUCATION

M.Tech – Industrial Engineering | VIT Pune | 2017–2019 | 9.13 CPI

B.E. – Mechanical Engineering | K.K. Wagh College of Engineering, Nashik | 2005–2010 | 62.4%

ADDITIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

Academic Excellence Award – Atlas Copco (2009).

Presented papers at national conferences including VIT and NITIE.

Recognised for leading large-scale transformation programmes across global engagements.

PROFILE POSITIONING FOR PROCESS ENGINEERING MANAGER

Targeting senior Process Excellence / Process Engineering leadership roles requiring Lean Six Sigma capability building, global transformation, consulting, stakeholder influencing, community development, innovation, Process/Data Discovery and AI-enabled continuous improvement.
